with a sniff.definitionKo: 콧구멍으로 숨을 띄엄띄엄 세게 내쉬는 소리.
with a sniff.englishDescription: A word imitating a strong breathing sound, which is made on and off, with one's nostrils.

with a swinging motion.definitionKo: 크게 춤추듯이 한 번 움직이는 모양.
with a swinging motion.englishDescription: In the manner of moving once with a big gesture as if one is dancing.

with a thrust.definitionKo: 크게 또는 깊이 찌르거나 박거나 찍는 모양.
with a thrust.englishDescription: A word describing an act of repeatedly prodding, knuckling, or spearing something severely or deeply.

with a thrust.definitionKo: 크게 또는 깊이 자꾸 찌르거나 박거나 찍는 모양.
with a thrust.englishDescription: A word describing an act of repeatedly prodding, knuckling, or spearing something severely or deeply.

with a thrust.definitionKo: 작게 또는 세게 한 번 찌르거나 박거나 찍는 모양.
with a thrust.englishDescription: A word describing an act of prodding, knuckling, or spearing something slightly or strongly once.
A word describing an act of ramming, prodding, or hitting something strongly.

with a thrust.definitionKo: 힘 있게 깊이 찌르거나 쑤시는 모양.
with a thrust.englishDescription: A word describing an act of stabbing or poking something strongly and deeply.

with a thrust.definitionKo: 칼이나 창 등으로 자꾸 세게 찌르거나 쑤시는 모양.
with a thrust.englishDescription: A word describing an act of stabbing or poking something repeatedly and strongly.

with a thrust.definitionKo: 작은 물건으로 자꾸 세게 찌르거나 쑤시는 모양.
with a thrust.englishDescription: A word describing the act of stabbing or poking something repeatedly and strongly.

with a wobble.definitionKo: 작은 바퀴가 단단한 바닥을 구르며 흔들리는 소리. 또는 그 모양.
with a wobble.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound or describing the movement of a small wheel rolling and wobbling on the hard ground.

with a wobble.definitionKo: 가늘고 긴 것이 탄력 있게 휘어지며 느리게 한 번 흔들리는 모양.
with a wobble.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of a thin, long object bending flexibly and waving slowly for one time.

with all one's might.englishDescription: To the utmost of one's ability.

with all one's might.definitionKo: 있는 힘을 다하여. 또는 힘이 닿는 데까지.
with all one's might.englishDescription: Exerting all one's power; or doing one's best.
with all one's might.englishExpression: with all one's might; as far as one can

with crisp sounds.definitionKo: 벼, 보리 등의 곡식을 계속해서 베는 소리.
with crisp sounds.englishDescription: A word imitating the sound of harvesting crops like rice, barley, etc., continuously.

with one look.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of looking at something briefly one time.
with one look.englishExpression: with one glance; with one look

with one's own hands.definitionKo: 남의 힘을 빌리지 않고 자기 손으로 직접.
with one's own hands.englishDescription: In person without receiving other's help.

woman's remarriage.definitionKo: 결혼했던 여자가 남편과 사별하거나 이혼한 후 다른 남자와 다시 결혼함.
woman's remarriage.englishDescription: The act of a woman remarrying someone after her husband's death or divorce.

woodblock-printed book.englishDescription: A book printed using a woodblock.

wooden rice chest.definitionKo: 쌀, 보리, 콩 등의 곡식을 담아 두는 데 쓰는 네모나고 큰 나무 상자.
wooden rice chest.englishDescription: A large wooden chest that is used to store grains such as rice, barley, beans, etc.

words.definitionKo: 특정한 뜻을 나타내는, 몇 낱말로 된 말.
words.englishDescription: A sequence of several words that expresses a certain meaning.

words.definitionKo: 생각이나 느낌을 표현하고 전달하는 사람의 소리.
words.englishDescription: Human voice through which thoughts or feelings are expressed and conveyed.

words.definitionKo: 생각이나 느낌을 표현하고 전달하는 행동이나 태도.
words.englishDescription: The act or attitude through which thoughts or feelings are expressed and conveyed.
One's words or way of talking.

words.definitionKo: 생각이나 느낌을 전달하려고 목소리로 표현한 것.
words.englishDescription: Something expressed with one's voice to convey a thought or feeling.

wrapper.englishDescription: What is left on the outside of something after its core or kernel has been removed.

wrapper.definitionKo: 물건을 싸거나 꾸리는 데 쓰는 종이나 비닐.
wrapper.englishDescription: Paper or plastic paper that is used to wrap or pack something.

wrigglingly.definitionKo: 물결 모양을 이루며 느리게 조금씩 자꾸 움직이는 모양.
wrigglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the manner of moving slowly, making a wavy, irregular pattern.

wrigglingly.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분을 자꾸 비틀거나 구부리며 움직이는 모양.
wrigglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of keeping moving while twisting or bending a body part.

wrigglingly.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분을 비틀거나 구부리며 움직이는 모양.
wrigglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of moving while twisting or bending a body part.

wrigglingly.definitionKo: 몸의 한 부분을 비틀거나 구부리며 조금씩 자꾸 움직이는 모양.
wrigglingly.englishDescription: A word describing the motion of repeatedly moving a body part by bending or twisting.

written accusation of a crime.definitionKo: 범죄 사실이나 범인을 고발하기 위해 수사기관에 내는 서류.
written accusation of a crime.englishDescription: A document that is offered to the police in order to report a crime or a criminal.

written agreement.definitionKo: 계약의 내용을 적고 계약이 성립되었음을 증명하는 문서.
written agreement.englishDescription: A document stating the terms and conditions of an agreement and which proves the contract's validity.

yelling.englishDescription: A loud voice when scolding someone.

yelling.definitionKo: 몹시 화가 나서 크게 소리를 지르거나 꾸짖음. 또는 그 소리.
yelling.englishDescription: An act or a sound of shouting loudly at or scolding someone out of anger.

yelp.definitionKo: 개가 무섭거나 아파서 자꾸 소리를 지르다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a dog to make yelping sounds out of fear or pain.

yelp.definitionKo: 강아지 등이 놀라거나 아파서 자꾸 짖다.
yelp.englishDescription: For a puppy, etc., to cry out due to fear or pain.

yelp.englishDescription: For a puppy, etc., to cry out due to fear or pain.
